subject: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intros — CloudSummit opportunity (next steps)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@amazon.com>, Michael Garcia <michael.garcia@amazon.com>, Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@cloudsummit.org>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intros — CloudSummit opportunity (next steps)

Hi Priya / Michael / Jordan,

Thanks again for the intro at CloudSummit last week — CloudSummit Inc. is a good match for Redwood’s hosted + dedicated offering and they flagged marketplace listing + co-sell as high priority. I started the ACE registration but want to align on the PDM/PSM handoff and a short mutual action plan so we don’t miss the marketplace cutoffs.

Quick asks:
- Can AWS confirm the PDM/PSM pair for this account and loop them into a 30-min kickoff?
- We attached the ACE registration form we’ll submit (ACE_registration_form.pdf) and a draft co-sell MOP (co-sell-MOP.xlsx) — can AWS review gating items below?

Gating items I want to surface now:
- Customer procurement timeline & any PO/contract pre-reqs for listing
- Expected marketplace listing SLA (lead time) and any additional AWS artifacts required
- Any specific co-sell materials AWS needs (customer references, ROI deck, pricing page)

Jordan — can you confirm the decision committee and any internal timelines?

Proposed next step: 30-minute triage call Thursday 8/16 10:00-10:30 PT. If that works for AWS PDM/PSM, we’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,

— Soojin Lee
Head of Partner Motion 
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@amazon.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@cloudsummit.org>
Cc: Michael Garcia <michael.garcia@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intros — CloudSummit opportunity (next steps)

Hi Soojin — great to meet you at CloudSummit. Thanks for the notes and the initial artifacts.

Quick answers:
- I will be the primary PDM on this opportunity. I’m looping Michael Garcia (cc) as the PSM who would support the co-sell engagement.
- Please send the ACE registration link receipt once submitted — we’ll need the HubSpot deal ID and a short one-page product summary for the AWS listing team.

On gating items:
- Marketplace listing lead time is typically 3–4 weeks after submission + review, but that can vary with documentation completeness.
- AWS will need SOC 2 Type II, contact for billing, and a short security factsheet (if you have a one-pager, upload to the ACE form).
- Co-sell materials: customer references are helpful but not strictly mandatory at intake. A pricing band and a one-page value prop for the partnership page are recommended.

I can join the 8/16 10:00 PT sync. If that still works, Michael and I will be there.

— Priya Sharma
Partner Development Manager — AWS Partner Network
priya.sharma@amazon.com
+1 206-555-4482

Attaching: ACE_registration_form.pdf (filled), co-sell-MOP.xlsx (draft), CloudSummit-SLAs.pdf (draft SLA)

Agenda for 8/16 10:00 PT (30 min):
- Introductions + roles (5 min)
- ACE intake status & outstanding artifacts (8 min)
- Co-sell mutual action plan / target dates (10 min)
- Immediate asks & owners (7 min)

Can we confirm a billing contact for marketplace listing? I’ve added Jordan as the primary customer contact, but we’ll need the purchaser/billing contact (name + email).

I’ll send the invite momentarily.

— Soojin

Adding a few operational/legal notes from my side before the kickoff:
- Procurement: CloudSummit has requested Redwood standard T&Cs; if AWS requires a specific marketplace terms flow we should note any deviations.
- Security artifacts: SOC 2 Type II attestation — we have the report ready; I’ll attach redacted cover to the Drive folder.
- Billing contact: Jordan, please share the billing contact for CloudSummit (name, email, purchasing cadence). We also need to know if CloudSummit prefers invoicing via AWS marketplace or direct PO to Redwood.

I’ll join tomorrow’s kickoff and can answer questions about timelines for contract redlines.

Thanks,
